en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a sepia-toned photograph of a large, ornate building along a tree-lined avenue and park. The building in the image has a notable tower and is surrounded by well-maintained gardens and walkways. On the reverse side, there is handwriting in Swedish, a Swedish postage stamp, and address lines, typical of early 20th-century postcards. The text 'Sundsvall, Esplanaden.' is printed on the photograph, identifying the location.
